crossRefs.note: So Hiram gave Solomon cedar timber and cypress timber according to all his desire.

people.name: Hiram
people.line: King of Tyre, ally of David and Solomon.

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: So Hiram gave Solomon cedar timber and cypress timber according to all his desire.
translations.bsb: So Hiram provided Solomon with all the cedar and cypress timber he wanted,
translations.kjv: So Hiram gave Solomon cedar trees and fir trees according to all his desire.
translations.asv: So Hiram gave Solomon timber of cedar and timber of fir according to all his desire.
